<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/restart_grid"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops the Runtime and Archiver fleet, then replaces the Grid with a
fresh instance of itself, so settings that only apply at startup take
effect without an operator having to restart the service by hand.

Runs on a short delay so this response reaches the client before the
socket goes away. Stopping the Runtime can itself take up to 30s, so the
new process may not be listening again for up to about that long.
